coconut oil.reason: Highly comedogenic, likely to clog pores

isopropyl myristate.reason: Very high comedogenic rating, a known pore-clogger

isopropyl palmitate.reason: High comedogenic rating, can clog pores

sodium lauryl sulfate.reason: Moderately comedogenic and also a harsh irritant

olive oil.reason: Mildly comedogenic for some skin types

fragrance.reason: Common allergen and sensitizer, can cause reactions with repeated use

alcohol denat.reason: Drying alcohol that strips the skin barrier over time

ethanol.reason: Drying alcohol, can disrupt the skin barrier at high concentrations

lemon extract.reason: Phototoxic and highly irritating, can cause burns in sunlight

lime extract.reason: Phototoxic, avoid on skin exposed to sun

peppermint oil.reason: Menthol causes tingling but irritates skin with repeated use

eucalyptus oil.reason: Irritating to sensitive skin and mucous membranes

tea tree oil.reason: Can be irritating at high concentrations, sensitizer with repeated use

sodium lauryl sulfate.reason: Harsh surfactant that disrupts the skin barrier

formaldehyde.reason: Carcinogen and sensitizer, causes allergic reactions

methylisothiazolinone.reason: Strong allergen and sensitizer, banned in many EU leave-on products

methylchloroisothiazolinone.reason: Strong allergen, frequently causes contact dermatitis

benzyl alcohol.reason: Can be irritating to sensitive skin at higher concentrations

phenoxyethanol.reason: Generally safe but can irritate sensitive skin in high amounts

retinol.reason: Can cause purging, dryness, and irritation — introduce slowly

glycolic acid.reason: AHA — can cause irritation and sun sensitivity if overused

salicylic acid.reason: BHA — usually well tolerated but can cause dryness at high percentages

citric acid.reason: Can be irritating at high concentrations, usually fine as a pH adjuster

menthol.reason: Cooling sensation can mask irritation; sensitizing over time

camphor.reason: Irritating and can be toxic in large amounts

hyaluronic acid.benefit: Powerful humectant that draws moisture into skin

squalane.benefit: Lightweight emollient, non-comedogenic, mimics skin's natural oils

azelaic acid.benefit: Anti-inflammatory, brightening, anti-acne, supports rosacea-prone skin

tranexamic acid.benefit: Brightening, reduces dark spots and melasma

lactic acid.benefit: Gentle AHA exfoliant, hydrating at low concentrations

zinc oxide.benefit: Mineral sunscreen, anti-inflammatory, calms acne-prone skin

betaine.benefit: Humectant, soothing, helps with moisture retention

bakuchiol.benefit: Gentle retinol alternative, anti-aging without irritation

peptides.benefit: Signal skin to produce collagen; firming and anti-aging

shea butter.benefit: Rich emollient, deeply moisturizing, contains fatty acids and vitamins

jojoba oil.benefit: Lightweight, closely mimics skin's sebum, non-comedogenic

rosehip oil.benefit: Rich in Vitamin C and retinoids, brightening and anti-aging

madecassoside.benefit: Calming, barrier repair, wound healing active from Centella Asiatica

resveratrol.benefit: Powerful antioxidant, anti-aging, protects against oxidative stress

castor oil.reason: Very thick and heavy, can weigh down low porosity hair

beeswax.reason: Occlusive, can block moisture absorption in low porosity hair

petroleum.reason: Heavy occlusive, not ideal for low porosity hair

lanolin.reason: Heavy and occlusive, may cause product buildup

coconut oil.reason: Heavy protein-rich oil that can cause buildup on low porosity hair
